column1: # Curated structured fact paths for Facter and OpenFact; availability depends on the target system.

column2: Operating system name, e.g. Ubuntu, CentOS, Darwin, windows.
Operating system family, e.g. Debian, RedHat, Suse, Darwin, windows.
Major component of the operating system release, e.g. 22.
Minor component of the operating system release, e.g. 04.
Hardware architecture as the operating system reports it, e.g. x86_64.
Hardware model, e.g. x86_64 or arm64.
Path to the Windows system32 directory.
MAC address of the primary interface.
Network address of the primary interface.
Name of the primary network interface.
Hash of every network interface, keyed by name.
Address of the DHCP server that configured the primary interface.
Kernel name, e.g. Linux, Darwin, windows.
Kernel version, without any release suffix.
Major component of the kernel version.
Percentage of system memory in use.
Hash of physical disks, keyed by device name.
Hash of disk partitions, keyed by device name.
Hash of mount points, keyed by path.
Name of the user running the agent.
User id of the user running the agent.
Primary group of the user running the agent.
Group id of the user running the agent.
Whether the agent is running with elevated privileges.
The PATH environment variable of the agent process.
Virtualisation technology, or physical when none.
System manufacturer as reported by DMI.
Product name as reported by DMI.
Serial number as reported by DMI.
SHA-256 fingerprint of the host RSA key.
Version of Facter producing these facts.
Version of the all-in-one agent package.
Ruby version the agent runs on.
Whether the system is running in FIPS mode.
